sections.heading: Sunflower Creative Arts - 6th Annual Hop, Skip & a Jump-a-Thon
sections.html:
June 5, 2020 UPDATE

Dear Sunflower Supporters,

After much consideration, in the interest of our community wellbeing, we have decided to cancel Hop, Skip & a Jump-a-thon.

We will use all team standings as of March 15 to award prizes and hold our

Finale

Raffle

all of which we will announce by the end

of the month. A BIG thanks to all of you who hav

e set up teams, gotten and given donations, volunteered or signed up to volunteer, and more! We look forward to more fun Sunflower events together when the time is right.

If you have any questions, please contact Ilysia Shattuck at .

ilysia@sunflowercreativearts.org

With gratitude,

The Sunflower Team

Join us for our 6th Annual crazy playful walkathon, where all funds raised will benefit Sunflower’s Play + Nature + Art programs.

This event is open to families of all ages and abilities, as well as strollers. The updated walkathon path will include hopscotch, music making, walking like your favorite animal, and much more!

Money raised will benefit Sunflower Creative Arts’ Play + Nature + Arts programs. If you can’t come, we’d love to have you pledge your support through one of our participating families.

Why we’re asking for your support

Because hands-on learning experiences in Play, Nature and the Arts are absolutely essential for healthy human development. Join Sunflower in making these experiences possible for more children!

Income from Sunflower programs covers only a portion of our budget. Generous financial gifts from friends and supporters make up the difference. Your support will help keep our garden green, our swings swinging and our cabinets stocked with paint, clay, glitter, glue and costumes. You’ll also help us educate our worldwide online and local real-life communities about the importance of Play + Nature + Art experiences. We couldn’t do it without you!

Many thanks to our 2020 Hop, Skip & a Jump Sponsors!

If you are interested in a business sponsorship please emaililysia@SunflowerCreativeArts.orgfor the details.

sections.heading: Finale Raffle Tickets NOW ON SALE!
sections.html:
March 10, 2020

A chance for a luxurious stay and an amazing way to support Sunflower!At least FOUR chances to win, including the💫✨Grand Prize✨💫

💫✨A three day/two night stay in a Cloister Estate Room atthe Boca Raton Resort & Club!✨💫

Other prizes include beautiful, ready-to-hang prints fromMeaghan Trust PhotographyandBen Hicks Fine Art, and a one-of-a-kind donation fromBarrel of Monks.

And by popular demand, we are now opening up ticket sales BEFORE the March 15th event! Starting Tuesday, March 10th, you may purchase Finale Raffle tickets in person at Sunflower Creative Arts for a suggested donation of one for $20, and three for $50 or onlinehere.

Additionally, EVERY HOP TEAM participating Sunday will automatically get one free Finale Raffle ticket. And for every $100 your team raises by 10am March 15th, you will get one more ticket. So, if you are a participating team and raise $200, you will get three Finale Raffle tickets - one for being a participating team, and two for the $200 you helped raised. And anyone at the event will also be able to get additional tickets for a suggested donation of one for $20, and three for $50.

Come Hop, Skip & Jump with us for your chance to win some fabulous prizes!

The small print:

This raffle drawing benefits Sunflower Creative Arts, Inc., a 501 (c)(3) organization. Address: 227 N Dixie Blvd, Delray Beach, FL 33444. All raffle prizes have been donated to Sunflower Creative Arts. The winners will be chosen on March 15, 2019 at 12:00pm and announced live at John Prince Park, Lake Worth. Winner need not be present to win. Suggested donation of $20 per one ticket, or $50 for three. While no purchase or contribution is necessary, one hundred percent of all contributions will benefit this organization, so we hope you will fully support us.

sections.heading: 2020 Hop Fundraising Prizes
sections.html:
March 9, 2020

Parents Weekend Out

The team who raises the most money will win this local "staycation" package, worth $500, including a two-day, one-night stay at Crane's Beach House, a $150 Gift Certificate for Benny's on the Beach, and other prizes to create a fantastic weekend.


Family Fun
This package, worth over $400, is for the team who gets the highest number of donors. It's filled with prizes including passes for Kayak Lake Worth, Boomers, Palm Beach Ice Works, and more.

250 Club Raffle

Any team who raises $250 or more will be entered into this raffle, with multiple chances to win prizes from places such as Milly Marzipan birthday party, avSpa of Delray facial and massage, passes to the Miami Zoo, and more.

Hopto it! Raffle
Any team who gets 2 or more donations of any amountwill be entered into this raffle, with 5 chances to win prizes including Trader Joe's, Ross Dress for Less, and BHair Artistry.
